trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own once the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is nothing extra to chase here. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then side stories, activities, collectibles, and the money and robbery cleanup — and this one lands last. PowerPyx rates the whole platinum at 4/10 difficulty and around 200 hours, with no online trophies at all.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies
The platinum unlocks automatically

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, so it is the first trophy most players will earn. Just play through the opening as the story directs and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed — the mission is mandatory.
steps: Start a new game
Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 and this unlocks at the chapter's end. Keep playing the story missions in order; there is no side requirement. Before the chapter closes, meditate at the spot by Jason's house — that first meditation spot is gone for good once Chapter 1 ends (see Positive Mental Attitude).
steps: Play the story missions through Chapter 1
Meditate at Jason's house before the chapter ends

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Story chapters unlock in order, so just keep following the mission markers. No side activity is needed for this one.
steps: Play the story missions through Chapter 2

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 to earn this. The story runs about 60 to 80 hours across its five chapters, so this is a mid-game milestone rather than a quick pop. Keep a manual save at the end of each chapter, since the game has no mission replay.
steps: Play the story missions through Chapter 3
Keep a manual save at each chapter end

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and this unlocks at the chapter's end. By now you are deep into the story, so keep the chapter-end manual saves going — with no mission replay, a save is your only way back to a missed story beat. Nothing else is required.
steps: Play the story missions through Chapter 4
Keep a manual save at each chapter end

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is for finishing the story's final mission, the last of the five chapters. Play the story through to its end and it pops when the credits roll. After the story, free roam opens up, so everything left can be cleaned up without time pressure.
steps: Play the story missions through the final mission
Free roam opens after the story for cleanup

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a mandatory story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you play through the campaign. No special approach is needed — finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
steps: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in the story
Complete it

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. This is one of the campaign's big set-piece heists and it unlocks automatically when the mission ends. Play it as the story presents it; there is no missable step inside it.
steps: Reach the mission The Cartel Heist in the story
Complete it

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies, it unlocks the moment the mission ends, with no extra condition. Just keep playing the story in order.
steps: Reach the mission Child's Play in the story
Complete it

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a mandatory mission, so the trophy comes with normal story progress. Finish the mission and it pops right away.
steps: Reach the mission Headliners in the story
Complete it

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The mission itself is mandatory, so the trophy unlocks when it ends. While you are at the airport, remember Catch Me If You Can — an unscheduled departure from VCIA — since you are already in the right place.
steps: Reach the mission VCIA Takedown in the story
Complete it

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story mission, so it unlocks naturally as the campaign reaches its endgame. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory in the story
Complete it

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is the hardest in the list: reach 100% completion on the in-game stats page. PowerPyx puts true completion at roughly 60% of the game's content — 200 of 277 base vehicles, 100 of 255 animals spotted with binoculars, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, and 300 of 397 stunts (though this trophy's own stunt count is 250). Only 15 of the 18 meditation spots count toward 100%, but the meditation trophy itself needs all 18, and Strangers & Freaks strands are NOT needed for 100%. Use the stats page as your checklist and save this for last.
steps: Open the in-game stats page to see what 100% still needs
Finish the story, activities, collectibles and challenges it lists
Strangers & Freaks strands are not needed for 100%

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and other driving feats — across Leonida. Stunts build up naturally while driving, but the fastest route is free-roam sessions dedicated to jumping ramps and threading traffic after the story. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total, and 300 of them are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy is a stepping stone to A Long Road.
steps: Drive fast and take jumps, near misses and drifts in free roam
Track the count on the stats page; 250 is the trophy, 300 counts toward 100%

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. The known types include fishing, bowling, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races and races; the in-game activities or stats screen shows how many of the nine you have covered, so check it and fill in the gaps. One try each is enough — no wins or medals are needed here.
steps: Open the activities or stats screen to see which types you have tried
Try one of each of the 9 activity types

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores accuracy and speed, so learn the gold threshold for each weapon class, then retry until you beat it — retries are free and you can attempt challenges in any order. Work through them one weapon at a time and use the range's own practice runs to learn the target layouts before going for gold.
steps: Visit a shooting range and open the challenge list
Gold each of the 42 challenges; retries are free
Practice a challenge first to learn its targets, then go for gold

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. PowerPyx counts 42 drone races in total across those 14 spots, but you only need one win per location, not all 42. Learn each course's corners in a practice run, then race to win; a win at a location checks it off for good.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race at a location
Win one race at each of the 14 locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race counts once, so repeating the same race does not help. Races run across Leonida on road and off-road courses; enter them from the race markers and work through the list. Shorter circuits are the fastest way to bank wins early.
steps: Find race markers across Leonida
Win 20 different races, one win per race

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges run through the fishing activity — cast, hook and land your catch faster or bigger than Cal manages. A good rod and the right spot help, but timing the hook and reeling steadily matter most.
steps: Open the fishing activity and find Cal's challenge
Out-fish Cal to win the challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Pick any cabinet, play its game through to the end, and the trophy pops when you finish. The shortest arcade game is the quickest route if you only want the trophy.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet
Play an arcade game through to completion

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's story strand. Andy is one of the side characters whose missions run alongside the main story — follow his mission markers until his strand ends. Side strands stay available in free roam after the story, so there is no rush.
steps: Follow Andy's mission markers
Complete Andy's final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's story strand. Kenton's missions run beside the main campaign — follow his markers until the strand closes. Like the other side strands, it can be finished in free roam after the story ends.
steps: Follow Kenton's mission markers
Complete Kenton's final mission

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's story strand. Billy's missions appear as you play through Leonida — follow his markers to the end of his strand. It stays available in free roam, so finish it whenever it fits your route.
steps: Follow Billy's mission markers
Complete Billy's final mission

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands — the odd jobs strangers hand out across Leonida. Stranger markers appear on the map as you explore; each strand is a short chain of missions. Note that these strands are NOT needed for 100% completion, so do them for the trophy itself, not for A Long Road.
steps: Find stranger markers on the map while exploring
Complete 8 full stranger mission strands

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's story strand. Randy's missions run alongside the main campaign — follow his markers until the strand ends. It can be finished in free roam after the story, so slot it into your side-story cleanup.
steps: Follow Randy's mission markers
Complete Randy's final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's story strand. Tyrone's missions appear through the campaign — follow his markers to the strand's end. Like the other side strands, it stays open in free roam after the story.
steps: Follow Tyrone's mission markers
Complete Tyrone's final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first spot, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, becomes permanently unavailable once Chapter 1 ends, so meditate there before the chapter closes. The other 17 spots stay open in free roam. Only 15 of the 18 count toward 100% completion, but the trophy itself needs all 18, so do not stop at 15.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at the spot at Jason's house — before the chapter ends
Find and meditate at the other 17 spots across Leonida

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt strand sends you after a one-of-a-kind animal — track it with the binoculars and the hunting clues the strand gives you, then take the shot. The hunt can be done in free roam after the story, so there is no time pressure.
steps: Follow Bret's hunt strand
Track the unique animal and hunt it

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, interiors and out in the world — and each set needs every card in it. Sweep an area at a time and tick cards off in this tracker as you find them; finishing any three full sets earns the silver.
steps: Search Leonida for collectible cards
Complete 3 full card sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. Each spot counts once, so keep moving — photograph or tag a spot, then move on to the next. Tourist landmarks, viewpoints and distinct districts are the natural places to rack up locations while you explore for The Goodtime State.
steps: Open the WAiNK feature at a location
WAiNK It at 100 different locations

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's side objectives, from driving feats to combat and exploration goals. Challenges tick over naturally as you play, and the challenge menu shows what is left. PowerPyx counts 80 challenges in total, with 70 of them counting toward 100% completion, so pushing past 50 also helps A Long Road.
steps: Open the challenges menu to see what is available
Complete 50 challenges across any categories

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The partner must be with you when the heat is on — start trouble together, break line of sight, and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. A quiet stretch of countryside or a good hiding spot beats trying to outrun the whole Leonida police force.
steps: Bring your partner along
Reach a 4-star wanted level together
Lose the cops and escape

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops back to back without losing your wanted level — the wanted level must stay live between all three robberies. Pick three shops close together, plan a fast route between them, and keep moving: if the wanted level drops, the chain breaks and you start over. A getaway car parked nearby helps.
steps: Bring your partner along
Rob a shop, then two more in a row
Keep the wanted level alive through all three

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or enter each one and it counts. Rare and mission vehicles help, but ordinary traffic covers most of the list: vary your routes, check new districts, and hop into anything you have not driven. PowerPyx counts 277 base vehicles, with 200 of them needed for 100% completion, so keep discovering past 100 for A Long Road.
steps: Drive or enter vehicles you have not used before
Discover 100 different vehicles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster — a shootout with five or more hostiles in range — then trigger Combat Focus and drop all five before it ends. A stocked weapon and a little cover make the difference; if you run out of targets, retry in a busier fight.
steps: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies in range
Trigger Combat Focus and down all 5 in one use

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA in a way no schedule covers. The description itself is the clue: get to the airfield and take a plane from the runway yourself, rather than boarding a scheduled flight. The VCIA Takedown mission puts you at the airport anyway, so try it around that mission.
steps: Get to Vice City International Airport
Depart in an unscheduled way — take a plane from the runway yourself

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description points at Rhino tanks: expect them when the military answers a high wanted level. Build up the heat until Rhinos roll in, then deal with them — survive the encounter or take one down, with heavy weapons and cover. No confirmed step-by-step method has been published yet, so treat the description as the clue and the wanted level as the trigger.
steps: Raise your wanted level until Rhino tanks respond
Deal with the Rhinos — survive or destroy one

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the approach first: case the store, find the quiet moment, and keep out of the staff's and cameras' sight while you take the goods. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, let the heat die down, and try again with a better route.
steps: Case a jewelry store and plan a quiet approach
Rob it without being detected

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is its own job: get in, crack the vault, grab the cash and get clear before the response closes in. Plan a getaway for every vault and treat each robbery as separate — the trophy counts completed escapes, so a failed escape does not count.
steps: Find a bank vault to rob
Rob the vault and escape
Repeat for 5 vaults in total

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck in free roam and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — find one, stop it, take the cash and get clear before the police close in. A fast getaway car and a planned escape route turn a messy robbery into a clean one.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route
Rob it and escape

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Every named district and region counts once, so a systematic sweep works best: drive each area's roads, visit its landmarks, and watch the area name appear. Pair this with the WAiNK locations, vehicle discoveries and card hunting — one road trip can feed three trophies at once.
steps: Drive through every district and region of Leonida
Visit all 52 areas; the area name appears as you enter it

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Each gang runs its own operations around Leonida — find one per gang, hit it, and get clear. The tracker in this guide lists the nine gangs, so tick each one off as you rob its operation.
steps: Find an illegal operation run by a gang
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Honest note: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known — no confirmed method has been published. The description points to a bar or spot with a view on Ocean Beach, so try the beachfront bars in free roam after the story. Do not trust any walkthrough that claims a confirmed route until a source publishes one.
steps: Head to Ocean Beach in free roam
Find a spot with a view and enjoy a cocktail

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Honest note: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known — no confirmed method has been published. The description points to a vehicle showroom and a very GTA exit: drive straight out through the glass. Try a showroom in free roam and check back when a guide confirms the exact spot.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom
Drive out through it in classic style

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — in other words, bowl a game there. Head to the Kolt & Associates alley, step up to a lane and play. This is a story-adjacent moment, so it may trigger during the campaign; if not, the alley stays open in free roam.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Bowl a game there

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — this one unlocks as a story moment during the campaign, when the partnership between the two leads hits the public eye. There is no separate task to do: keep playing the story and it pops when the moment arrives. PowerPyx lists it among the story moments rather than a free-roam activity.
steps: Play through the story
The trophy unlocks at the partnership story moment

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the choices you make as you play, for better or worse. Just play the game: story choices, side activities and the way you handle encounters all feed the count. Warning from PowerPyx and GTABase: do NOT push your profile toward Irredeemable — that status is permanent, so let the count grow naturally instead of chasing the worst choices.
steps: Play the game and make choices as you go
Let the 500-action count grow naturally
Do not push toward Irredeemable — it is permanent

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Honest note: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known — no confirmed method has been published. The description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but until a source confirms what that something is, there is no reliable route to give. Check back when the guides catch up.
steps: No confirmed method yet — watch for an update from the cited guides

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Honest note: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known — no confirmed method has been published. The description suggests witnessing something strange or unexplained out in Leonida, but no source has confirmed the trigger yet. Explore odd spots and keep an eye on the cited guides for the first confirmed report.
steps: No confirmed method yet — watch for an update from the cited guides

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Honest note: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known — no confirmed method has been published. The description points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, knocking someone down as you drive past. Until a source confirms the exact setup, the safe read is: melee weapon in hand, vehicle moving, target on foot.
steps: No confirmed method yet — watch for an update from the cited guides

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists — the cash you take is dirty until it is cleaned. Feed it through your laundering contacts over time; the total is cumulative, so keep laundering as you earn. Save this for the cleanup stage, when the robberies have already filled your pockets.
steps: Rob banks, vaults and trucks to earn marked bills
Launder the bills through your contacts
Reach $250,000 laundered in total

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — vehicles, clothes, weapons, anything the shops of Leonida sell. The total is cumulative across every shop, so normal buying through the game already moves the needle. If you are short at the end, a big vehicle purchase closes the gap fast; by the cleanup stage you should have the cash from laundering and robberies.
steps: Buy vehicles, clothes and weapons as you play
Spend $100,000 across all shops in total

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties across Leonida. Garages go on sale as you explore new districts — buy each one when you find it, since a garage also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. By the time you have explored all 52 areas, the eight garages should all be yours.
steps: Explore Leonida to find garage properties for sale
Buy all 8 garages

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it — each registration counts once. Ten different vehicles is the target, so register as you discover new rides and the trophy pops well before you run out of vehicles to find.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app
Register 10 different vehicles
